SOOPPIY DOCS — TRADING GATEWAY SETUP

Connect Webull

How to create the API credentials at Webull and connect them on the Accounts page. shadow first — live rollout in progress

1Before you start

  • An account at Webull that has finished the venue's identity verification — an unverified account can create a key but cannot trade with it.
  • Two-factor authentication switched on at Webull. Every venue asks for a 2FA code (and often an email confirmation) at the moment you create the key.
  • This page open next to the venue's site, and somewhere safe to hold the secret for the minute between creating it and connecting it.

2Availability and local rules

Webull Financial LLC, a US broker-dealer, for US-listed stocks and ETFs. OpenAPI trading is offered to Webull US account holders; residency and account eligibility are decided by Webull's own onboarding. US market hours and pattern-day-trading rules apply to your account, not to Sooppiy.

Sooppiy does not decide who may use a venue — the venue's own KYC does, and your local law does. Connecting a gateway here does not make a venue available to you, and a venue you cannot legally use will simply refuse your key. This is factual guidance, not legal advice; access rules change, so confirm on the venue's own terms page for your country.

3What you need

  • API key
  • API secret
Grant TRADE permission only — never withdrawal. Use the venue's IP allowlist when it offers one. Start small. Your keys are encrypted at rest (AES-GCM) on Sooppiy's server and are never shown again after you save them.
IP restriction — leave it unset for now. Some venues let you lock a key to one server address. Sooppiy is moving its hosting region, and a key pinned to the old address would stop working the moment it moves. One consequence worth diarising: Binance and Bybit disable an unrestricted key's trading permission after 90 days, so plan to revisit the key then.

4Create your credentials at Webull

  1. Log in at developer.webull.com with your Webull account and open Developer Console → API Keys.
  2. Create an application to get an App Key and App Secret. The secret is shown once. Production approval can take 1–2 business days.
  3. For shadow mode, switch the console to paperTrade and apply for OpenAPI for PaperTrade — that gives a separate App Key/Secret pair for the PaperTrade environment. Use the PaperTrade pair while you run shadow; replace it with the production pair when you go live.
The secret is shown exactly once, at creation. If you close that screen without copying it you cannot recover it — you have to delete the key and make a new one. Sooppiy never shows it again either, once saved.

5Where each value goes

At Webull it is calledPaste it into Sooppiy's field
App KeyAPI key
App SecretAPI secret

6Connect it on the Accounts page

  1. Open Accounts → Trading gateway.
  2. Pick your region (ordering only — every broker stays available) and choose Webull.
  3. Paste the credentials from step 2.
  4. Read and accept the live-trading terms — required even if you only plan to use shadow.
  5. Press Connect gateway. The account starts in paper mode: nothing is sent to Webull yet.
  6. Switch the account to shadow (recommended first) or live on the account card.

7After you connect

  1. The gateway appears under Connected gateways with a health line. Key-pair venues show “credentials on file” — normal, it means there is no session to probe.
  2. Your automation rules do not switch by themselves. A rule only reaches Webull when you set that rule's account type to shadow or live.
  3. Start in shadow and read the Drift records panel for a few days before considering live.
  4. To revoke access at any time, delete the key at Webull — that stops every order instantly, whatever Sooppiy is set to.

8What each mode does with Webull

ModeWhat happens
paperpaper / simulator — every trade stays on Sooppiy's internal ledger. Webull is never contacted.
shadowshadow — fills stay simulated and the same order is ALSO sent to Webull's PaperTrade environment for comparison; the drift is journalled. This needs PaperTrade app keys.
livelive — not yet open for Webull: the venue is in its shadow rollout soak, and live routing is refused with an explicit message until Sooppiy enables it platform-wide. Your rules can run in shadow meanwhile. Newly enabled venues also carry a $1,000 per-order limit at first (over-limit orders are refused, never resized).
Whatever mode you use, the Broker orders and Drift records panels at the bottom of the Accounts page show what Webull actually confirmed next to what the ledger assumed — differences are surfaced loudly, never auto-corrected.

9Venue notes

  • US stocks only, at 1x: buys, sells, short sales and covers are sent as market DAY orders in the regular session (a short is Webull side SHORT, a cover is a BUY). Shorts follow the platform's short-selling switch; crypto, options and leverage are never sent to Webull.
  • Short sales need a Webull margin account. If your login holds more than one account, enter the account id in the optional field when you connect — Sooppiy will not guess, and when it has to choose it picks the single cash account, which cannot short. With one account it is found automatically.
  • Production apps can have Webull's two-factor token switched on. Sooppiy does not create that token yet; an app that requires it answers 401 and the order is refused, never filled on paper.

10Troubleshooting

SymptomWhat it means / what to do
“credentials are missing or cannot be decrypted”The stored key can no longer be read (for example after a server key rotation). Reconnect the broker with fresh credentials.
“live-trading terms have not been accepted”Accept the terms for this broker on the Accounts page — consent is recorded per broker.
“not yet enabled for live orders on this platform”The venue is still in its shadow rollout. Shadow works today; live opens when the soak completes.
401 on every orderProduction keys used in shadow (PaperTrade) or the reverse, a revoked key, or the app requires a two-factor token. Match the key pair to the mode you are in.
“Webull returned N accounts”Your login holds several accounts. Reconnect and enter the account id of the one to trade.
